description: Delivered (landed) cost for up to 10 products to one destination: items, shipping, duties estimate, tax and the DDP total in USD cents — the same numbers the store's own checkout charges. For Canada the card is charged in CAD at a fixed rate; charged.amountCents shows that. Returns supported:false with a message for destinations we do not ship to (South Korea, sanctioned countries).

postal_code.description: Destination postal code — for Canada it sets the provincial tax rate

quantities.description: Same length as product_ids; default 1 each

ship_to.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CA, US, JP)

name: nodajimarket_get_landed_cost
title: Estimate delivered cost
